system.description:
Casts a cone of cold 60 feet long and 30 feet wide at the far end. Creatures in the cone take 6d6 points of cold damage, but they may make a saving throw vs. wands for half damage. Holds 25 charges.

This wand cannot be recharged.

This dark, polished wand feels heavy in your hand, its surface etched with frost-like patterns. The tip is capped with a translucent blue crystal that resembles ice, and a faint mist occasionally emanates from it, hinting at the chilling power within.
system.unidentifiedDesc: A slim, smoothly finished stick about 18" (45 cm) long, the wand fits comfortably in one hand. Its surface shows faint runes and hairline veins; one end tapers to a rounded tip while the other terminates in a small carved motif. It feels surprisingly light and balanced.
